patches_added.name: Block P2P video relay
patches_added.description: Strips TikTok's peer-to-peer CDN libraries so your phone is not used as a relay node for other people's video traffic. Saves battery and mobile data.

patches_added.name: Block contact list access
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok from reading your phone contacts. Find Friends and People you may know lose access to your contact list.

patches_added.name: Block installed app scanning
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok from reading the list of apps installed on your phone. TikTok uses this for device fingerprinting and ad targeting.

patches_added.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches_added.description: Shows a small colored dot when TikTok accesses the camera or microphone. Green for camera, orange for microphone. Stays visible until the access ends.

patches_added.name: Device privacy guard
patches_added.description: Blocks TikTok from reading your clipboard contents and scanning devices on your local network. Clipboard writes (copying links you asked for) are not affected.

patches_added.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches_added.description: Makes TikTok's reviewed Fresco animated-frame cache lookups return no cached frame. This can increase decoding work or change animation playback.

patches_added.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok from injecting JavaScript tracking interfaces into the in-app browser's WebView. Links redirected to the system browser by Open external links directly are not affected.

patches_added.name: Limit background traffic
patches_added.description: Turns off TikTok's buffer-preload gate and skips its push initialization task. Videos may start buffering later, and TikTok push notifications may stop.

patches_added.name: Location access governor
patches_added.description: Blocks TikTok from reading your real GPS location. Location requests return null. Goes beyond the SIM and region spoof, which changes the locale and timezone but not the coordinates.

patches_added.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches_added.description: Empties TikTok's link-mic and LIVE match or minigame assets, then skips its gift-effect widget setup. Co-hosting, games and animated gifts may stop.

patches_added.name: Remove content credential and card scanner assets
patches_added.description: Empties TikTok's bundled C2PA and Microblink card-scanning assets, Pitaya AI engine libraries, the live-cast dynamic feature, and runtime monitoring probes.

patches_added.name: Remove creation tools
patches_added.description: Empties TikTok's reviewed editor, camera-effect and face-model assets. Recording, editing, effects and creator tools may stop working.

patches_added.name: Remove unused language packs
patches_added.description: Empties unselected TikTok language bundles while always keeping English. Selected language codes are checked before any file changes.

patches_added.name: Resource and battery governor
patches_added.description: Blocks TikTok from polling device sensors for fingerprinting and throttles background buffer preloading. Reduces battery drain from motion tracking and prefetch.

patches_added.name: Skip the splash ad
patches_added.description: Stops TikTok's splash-ad preload tasks and returns false from its reviewed splash and TopView gates. Other startup behavior is left in place.

patches_added.name: Skip update checks
patches_added.description: Skips TikTok's background and boot-finished device-ID update-check tasks. This may suppress some in-app update checks. Play Store updates are unaffected.

patches_added.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches_added.description: Kills the Pitaya on-device ML inference engine at startup so it cannot build a behavioral profile. The AI asset strip in the core de-bloat patch removes the native libraries; this stops the initialization code that would download replacements.

patches_removed.name: Core Asset De-bloat
patches_removed.description: Empties TikTok's bundled C2PA native libraries and Microblink payment-card OCR assets. Content credentials and card scanning may stop. Choose this patch to enable it.

patches_removed.name: Instant Launch & Splash Blocker
patches_removed.description: Stops TikTok's splash-ad preload tasks and returns false from its reviewed splash and TopView gates. Other startup behavior is left in place. Choose this patch to enable it.

patches_removed.name: Language Pack Purger
patches_removed.description: Empties unselected TikTok language bundles while always keeping English. Selected language codes are checked before any file changes. Choose this patch to enable it.

patches_removed.name: Live Stream Suite Optimizer
patches_removed.description: Empties TikTok's link-mic and LIVE match or minigame assets, then skips its gift-effect widget setup. Co-hosting, games and animated gifts may stop. Choose this patch to enable it.

patches_removed.name: Network & Background Traffic Governor
patches_removed.description: Turns off TikTok's buffer-preload gate and skips its push initialization task. Videos may start buffering later, and TikTok push notifications may stop. Choose this patch to enable it.

patches_removed.name: Runtime Memory Governor
patches_removed.description: Makes TikTok's reviewed Fresco animated-frame cache lookups return no cached frame. This can increase decoding work or change animation playback. Choose this patch to enable it.

patches_removed.name: Studio & Creation De-bloat
patches_removed.description: Empties TikTok's reviewed editor, camera-effect and face-model assets. Recording, editing, effects and creator tools may stop working. Choose this patch to enable it.

patches_removed.name: Update Prompt Suppressor
patches_removed.description: Skips TikTok's background and boot-finished device-ID update-check tasks. This may suppress some in-app update checks. Play Store updates are unaffected. Choose this patch to enable it.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches_modified.description: Replaces TikTok's dark background palette with black or a chosen color. The light theme keeps its colors. It is the one patch that rewrites resources, so patching with it on needs the memory limit raised to 768 MB.

patches_modified.name: Block author button
patches_modified.description: Adds one-tap controls for blocking the creator, hiding them locally and blocking the current sound. The local-hide and sound controls have separate switches. Long press any visible control to move it, and all of them hide while comments are open.

patches_modified.name: Comment tools
patches_modified.description: Hides comments that contain chosen words or come from chosen accounts, turns the thumbs down on each comment into a block button that shows the block symbol, makes a web address in a comment tappable, hides comment media and polls, and adds a box above the comments that narrows them by what they say or who said it.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, including videos with creator commission disclosures, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, LIVE replays, stories, photo posts, paid partnerships, AI labeled videos, verified accounts, series, playlists, the playlist bar, the floating event badge and inserted cards. Videos can also be filtered by your own caption words, creator handles or patterns, sound names, length, the country they were posted from and their view, like, comment, favorite and share counts. Sponsored cards are dropped from the profile video viewer, the search grids and the Friends tab as well as the feed, and so are the mid-roll ads TikTok splices into a video pager after the list has loaded. The share prompt that appears after a like can also be hidden.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the save button from video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Remove Wildberries ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Wildberries home banners, grid banners, profile banners, promo headers, product recommendations, and lottery popups.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ozon ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Ozon ad widgets, banner carousels, video ads, and PDP promo blocks.
